items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 22 September 2026 4:40pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Mostly dry with only occasional drizzle and a continued risk of coastal mist and fog patches in places, best of the sunshine in the north and west. Rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7, mainly later.


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15, veering NW 20-25 with gusts of 30-35 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle and mist, or very poor in fog patches. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Today##

Heavy rain at first and breezy, but quickly clearing up in morning, with sunny spells then developing as winds ease. Clear overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 5°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 at first.


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

North or NW 15-20, 20-25 in places, soon decreasing 10-15, 15-20 in places, then becoming Variable 05-10 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first. Patchy hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first.


##Tomorrow##

##Temperature##

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later. Hill fog later.


##Comments##
